pc2024.about: Ollama on PC2024, from PC2024 itself (where the weekly paw runs). Ollama is not a catsitter GPU tenant: the image generator must be off the card, or the model spills into system RAM.

pc2024-lan.about: The same Ollama from another machine on the home network.

pc2024-jarvis.about: JarvisEvo-8B (a Qwen3-VL-8B photo-retouching fine-tune) served by mochi-jarvis's llama-server; take the GPU lease first (POST :5280/api/gpu {"action":"acquire","name":"mochi-jarvis"}).

azure.about: Azure Foundry's OpenAI-compatible endpoint: set AZURE_FOUNDRY_ENDPOINT to https://<resource>.services.ai.azure.com.
